title: Derived sections through finite pushforward for module sheaves
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring, $p:Z\to Y$ a finite morphism of schemes [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], and $M$ a bounded-below complex of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules on the small etale site of $Z$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Direct image $p_*$ on these module sheaves is exact and sends injective objects to injective objects. There is a canonical natural isomorphism $\lambda_{p,M}:R\Gamma(Y,p_*M)\xrightarrow{\sim}R\Gamma(Z,M)$ [def-kun-rgamma-unbounded]. Its normalization is: for a bounded-below injective resolution $M\to L$, $p_*L$ is a bounded-below injective resolution of $p_*M$, and $\lambda_{p,M}$ is induced by $\Gamma(Y,p_*L)=\Gamma(Z,L)$.

For an arbitrary scheme morphism $h:Y'\to Y$, form $Z'=Y'\times_Y Z$ with projections $g:Z'\to Z$ and $p':Z'\to Y'$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $\beta_M:h^{-1}p_*M\to p'_*g^{-1}M$ be the adjoint of the counit map $(p')^{-1}h^{-1}p_*M=g^{-1}p^{-1}p_*M\to g^{-1}M$; inverse image and these adjunctions are the exact module functors of [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact]. The square with horizontal arrows $\lambda_{p,M}$ and $\lambda_{p',g^{-1}M}$ and vertical arrows
$$R\Gamma(Y,p_*M)\xrightarrow{\mathrm{res}_h}R\Gamma(Y',h^{-1}p_*M)\xrightarrow{R\Gamma(\beta_M)}R\Gamma(Y',p'_*g^{-1}M),\qquad R\Gamma(Z,M)\xrightarrow{\mathrm{res}_g}R\Gamma(Z',g^{-1}M)$$
commutes in $D(\operatorname{Mod}\Lambda)$. Here restriction is the map induced by the inverse-image/direct-image unit. Only the displayed canonical mate is used; no base-change isomorphism is a hypothesis of this compatibility assertion.
